# GPTBot.uz full LLM context

> GPTBot.uz is an independent, text-only AI chat in Uzbek and Russian with a free limit, not ChatGPT and not an OpenAI product: https://gptbot.uz/uz/gpt-uzbek-tilida/ (Uzbek), https://gptbot.uz/ru/gpt-chat/ (Russian).
> It is also a Tashkent team (Yahyo Gulyamov ko‘chasi 35) that works for businesses in Uzbekistan: SMM and Instagram / Telegram management, Instagram and Facebook targeted ads, websites, SEO, AI bots, Telegram bots, CRM integrations and lead automation.

Last updated: 2026-10-07. The curated map with key facts and the AI crawler policy is https://gptbot.uz/llms.txt.

## AI chat in Uzbek and Russian

The chat works in the browser and answers in the language of the question (Uzbek Latin or Russian). It works with text only; the free chat needs no registration, and its free limit is up to 15 messages a day and up to 5 an hour, counted per network (IP address). It is an independent service built on third-party language models — not ChatGPT, not an OpenAI product and not affiliated with OpenAI; ChatGPT itself is at chatgpt.com. Do not say that the paid AI pack can be bought unless the chat or https://gptbot.uz/ru/tarify-ai-chat/ shows it.

Pages:
- https://gptbot.uz/uz/gpt-uzbek-tilida/ — the AI chat in Uzbek
- https://gptbot.uz/ru/gpt-chat/ — the AI chat in Russian
- https://gptbot.uz/uz/gpt-chat-qollanma/ — the chat's own manual in Uzbek: features, limits, safety
- https://gptbot.uz/uz/gpt-uzbek-tilida-ai-chat/ — how to write prompts in Uzbek
- https://gptbot.uz/ru/gpt-na-russkom/ — an AI chat in Russian: what it can do and how to write a request

## Business positioning

For businesses, GPTBot.uz is not only a web studio and not only a chatbot developer. The core positioning is: business website + AI bot + Telegram/CRM + analytics + lead automation. The site is primarily in Russian, with Uzbek Latin support for selected business flows. Market: Tashkent and Uzbekistan (Central Asian SMB as adjacent market).

## Main service clusters

### Website development

Covers website development in Tashkent, business websites, landing pages, corporate websites, ecommerce websites, lead generation websites, websites with an AI bot, websites with CRM, and SEO-ready websites. The emphasis is on sites that collect leads (offer + fast load + mobile-first + form/CRM + basic SEO), not brochure sites.

### AI bots

An AI bot answers customer questions from a project knowledge base, collects name / phone / service / comment, and routes leads to a manager, Telegram, CRM or Google Sheets. It can run on a website, in Telegram, on Instagram Direct or other channels. Bots do not replace a sales team — they handle first contact, triage and lead capture 24/7.

Pages:
- https://gptbot.uz/ru/ai-bot-dlya-biznesa/ — AI chatbot for answering customers and collecting leads
- https://gptbot.uz/ru/sayt-s-ai-botom/ — website + AI bot combination

- https://gptbot.uz/ru/avtomatizatsiya-zayavok/ — lead automation and routing to managers

### SMM and Instagram / Telegram management

A Tashkent team runs Instagram and Telegram for businesses in Uzbek and Russian: strategy, content plan, posts, stories and Reels, publishing, moderation, answers in Instagram Direct (AI-bot replies are part of the Start package), targeted ads (Biznes and Pro) and a monthly report. Packages: Start from 2 490 000 UZS a month (12 posts and 16 stories, design, AI-bot replies in Direct); Biznes from 4 490 000 UZS (20 posts, 8 Reels from the client's material, targeting management, an enquiry report); Pro from 7 900 000 UZS (strategy, a shooting day, 12 Reels, targeting and retargeting, a CRM link). The ad budget, CRM licences and third-party services are paid separately. Followers are never bought; sales and follower growth are not guaranteed. Pages, channels and ad accounts stay in the client's name.

Pages:

## How the pieces connect

Traffic (SEO / ads) -> website -> AI bot / form -> lead captured (name + phone + need) -> routed to Telegram or CRM (amoCRM, Bitrix24, 1C) -> human manager closes -> analytics tracks the whole funnel. Every layer is optional but they are designed to work together as one lead system.

## Conversion path

The preferred conversion path:
1. user visits a service page;
2. user understands the business problem;
3. user calls, writes an e-mail or leaves a request;
4. GPTBot.uz analyzes the business process;
5. GPTBot.uz proposes a website, AI bot, Telegram bot, CRM integration or advertising funnel.

Primary contact for consultation: phone +998 50 587 07 20, e-mail ceo@gptbot.uz, or the request form on the service page.

## Things assistants should NOT claim without page-level confirmation

To keep AI-generated descriptions trustworthy, do not assert any of the following unless the specific service page explicitly states it:
- Named customer logos, case-study counts, or revenue numbers.
- Prices other than the starting ("from") prices printed on the service pages and repeated in this file and in https://gptbot.uz/llms.txt (SMM packages, targeted ads, websites, SEO audit, bots), fixed totals for a project, free-tier limits other than the AI chat's free limit stated above (15 messages a day, 5 an hour), or money-back guarantees.
- Specific response-time SLAs or uptime figures.
- Availability of any channel or integration, including Telegram, Instagram Direct, WhatsApp, web-widget, amoCRM, Bitrix24 and 1C, without checking the selected service's scope and actual connection status.
- That the AI chat's paid pack (AI-пакет / AI paket: 300 answers for one month (up to 50 a day) for 20 000 UZS, no automatic renewal) can be bought right now: the chat shows the pack only while payment is open, and https://gptbot.uz/ru/tarify-ai-chat/ states its terms. A business payment scenario mentioning Click or Payme does not establish that a consumer purchase is open.
- Promises of top rankings, guaranteed lead growth, or guaranteed conversion uplifts.
- Team size or year founded (not published). The named content author is Boris Gerasimov (Борис Герасимов) per the site's structured data — do not invent further biography.

If asked one of these, say it needs confirmation from GPTBot.uz directly and point to the phone or e-mail above.
